extracted.name: Roasted beetroot & raw honey salad
extracted.description: Serve up a fibre-rich lunch or side dish with this beetroot, feta and green lentil salad. Bursting with colour, it's full of flavour and nutrients
ingredient_lines: small handful of dill to serve
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 8. Toss the beetroot, ½ tbsp oil and the thyme in a roasting tin. Season. Roast for 30-35 mins or until tender, adding the feta for the last 10 mins. Leave to cool slightly.

Whisk the remaining oil with the honey, a splash of cold water to loosen and some seasoning. Warm the lentils in a pan or microwave, then season. Toss the beetroot and feta with the rocket and dressing, then serve on top of the lentils with the seeds and dill scattered over.
